purpose: Bind source allocation classes and lifetimes to externally sampled VMAs without changing predictor bytes or allocating marker memory.

transport.ownership: The runner opens a fresh O_APPEND evidence file or pipe before exec and passes only its decimal descriptor number.
transport.fixed_registry_authority: Marker builds use a zero-initialized fixed BSS registry to bind explicit releases; registry exhaustion, duplicate live bases, or unknown releases fail attribution.
transport.short_write: retry until the complete fixed record is written
transport.failure: latch marker state invalid; authority-bearing runner must fail when the terminal marker-health check is false
transport.disabled: With the environment absent, marker calls perform no write and receive zero attribution authority.

source_insertions: fxcmv1::alloc after successful calloc and before first model-visible use
fxcmv1::alloc1 after both base and aligned pointers are fixed and before first model-visible use
ContextManager constructor after each history/shared/indirect vector reaches final capacity
Mixer constructor after slab allocation and before its first memset
PPMd StartSubAllocator after anonymous or file-backed arena creation
Every source-bound explicit release before free or munmap
Every file-backed allocator MADV_PAGEOUT call after a zero return
synchronization: The external observer associates each allocator-returned usable pointer with the containing /proc VMA by PID plus proc_start_ticks and monotonic sample sequence. allocation_base is the allocator-returned storage base, not an asserted VMA start. Raw pointer values never enter codec state hashes.
claim_boundary: Marker evidence is diagnostic-only and has zero memory qualification authority.
An instrumented binary cannot substitute for an uninstrumented guarded memory qualification.
Missing, malformed, duplicate, reordered, or geometrically invalid records invalidate attribution.
Allocation attribution cannot prove reclaimability or probability identity.
